about: Instrument-check judgments for runs/eval3, from the differences in runs/eval3/report.json (instrument). Explorer and crawls ran back-to-back per page. A page is excluded when a difference is content (or content data); differences that are manifests, icons, consent, ads, syncs, telemetry or per-load random hosts are non-content.

noncontent_ok.kenwheeler-github-io-slick: the seed URL without its trailing slash; two ad-sync setuid requests
noncontent_ok.flickity-metafizzy-co: Twitter widget syndication URL differs by query only
noncontent_ok.keen-slider-io-examples: web app manifest and its android-chrome icon (browser-only fetches)
noncontent_ok.developer-mozilla-org-en-us-docs-web-css: example runner on a random mdnplay.dev subdomain per load, rotating ad images, telemetry, manifest
noncontent_ok.admission-usc-edu-apply-faq: web app manifest; WordPress emoji polyfill, loaded by feature detection
noncontent_ok.www-bbc-co-uk-news-in-pictures: Optimizely datafile, web app manifests and icon only in the crawl
noncontent_ok.getbootstrap-com-docs-5-3-components-acc: web app manifest and its icon
